name: a regrade reads the rows observed by its own instant: one seen after the first pass, none seen after the regrade
notes: Sprint 1 close (QA-VR1, TECH-R4): written from docs/grading.md alone, so that a cross-check reading candidates at the first pass's evaluatedAt, or ignoring observedAt, disagrees with the contract.

c1 (muse, priya@company.com, 'Q3 deck', 14:02, minute precision; observedAt 14:02): unit [14:02, 14:03], window [14:00, 14:48] (§4.1). Address claim with a subject: applicable timeProximity 2500, counterpartyExact 3500, counterpartyDomain 1500, subjectOverlap 1500; Σw = 9000 (§5.2). The grant binds gmail.sent to acct-a.

Gmail Sent passes (acct-a): e1 synced 14:40 saw [12:00, 14:40] and first saw o1 (observedAt 14:40, stated: the loader default only reads entries synced by the first pass); e2 synced 15:10 saw [12:00, 15:10] and first saw o2 (observedAt 15:10, stated).

o1 raj@company.com 'Q3 deck' at 14:02: inside the unit → Δ 0, tp 1; ce 0 (another mailbox, all ASCII, not a +tag difference → no cp.* code); cd 1 (same non-common domain company.com); subject {q3, deck} vs {q3, deck} → 1. S = (2500 + 0 + 1500 + 1500)/9000 = 5500/9000 = 11/18.

First grading at 14:30 (§3): e1, e2, o1 and o2 all come later, so they are ignored. No eligible interval overlaps the window → no_coverage → UNVERIFIABLE, PENDING (no_coverage finalises only at end + 24 h), reasons coverage.none {gmail.sent}, match.none.

Event 1, regrade at 14:45 (§8: the stored receipt is PENDING and 14:45 ≥ 14:30, so it is installed). §3 at 14:45: e1 (14:40) is visible, e2 (15:10) is not; o1 (observed 14:40) is a candidate, o2 (observed 15:10) is not. Coverage: e1 covers [12:00, 14:40] of [14:00, 14:48] → partial. Best = o1, 11/18: not verified (10000·5500 < 8500·9000), partial (10000·5500 ≥ 5000·9000) → rule partial → PARTIAL; o1 assigned (≥ partial) → observationIds [o1].

State (§8): PARTIAL is FINAL only once graceElapsed: a sync ≥ end + 30 = 14:33 and ≥ end + 45 = 14:48. The only visible sync is 14:40 → PENDING; computedAt 14:45, no finalAt. Reasons: the partial rule adds no code; the grant has no allowlist, so allowlist.unchecked is not emitted; match.best {o1}; no cp.* (o1's address is another mailbox, not a +tag).

Traps: candidates read at the first pass's 14:30 give no candidate (best null, not 11/18); candidates read without the observedAt filter give o2 (74/99, PARTIAL on o2). No orphan: o1 is assigned and o2 is seen by neither grading.
